title: Claude Code /goal Mode: Set a Target and Let Claude Work Until It's Done
summary: Claude Code's /goal command runs autonomously toward a condition without hand-holding. Plus: the new claude agents dashboard and fast mode on Opus 4.7. Full guide.
body_markdown: Not effectively.` /goal` needs a verifiable end condition — something Haiku can evaluate as pass or fail after each turn. Open-ended tasks lack that exit signal, so the loop has no reliable termination point. Stick to tasks with a clear, checkable finish line.
